testsGenerated.description: Add two [P1] generated-RTL formal cover properties for full-slot cancellation and immediate next-cycle transaction acceptance; existing width 1 and 8 real-tool runs exercise both.

summary: Generated two P1 cover properties within the existing past_valid block, preserving all existing assertions, assumptions, and product code. Each cover requires an actual prior full queue, cancellation at that prior edge, and an empty queue with controls deasserted and ghost_push true on the next sampled edge. The flush cover explicitly excludes reset at cancellation. As positive conjunctions rather than implications, these covers cannot pass solely because a cancellation antecedent never occurs. Existing initial reset and legal-producer assumptions permit filling, cancellation, and fresh acceptance; no assumptions are added. The reset cover intentionally allows simultaneous flush because reset has priority. Full state requires two real input transactions under existing queue invariants. Coverage demonstrates reachability, not universal recovery correctness; unchanged prove assertions supply the safety contract. Both covers must still be reached by real SymbiYosys runs for widths 1 and 8, within the existing depth 12. No tools or tests were run and no PASS is claimed. Real hardware tools are required by the task, so HTTP/UI/Pact and mocks are inapplicable; no new fixtures are needed. totalTests counts the two new formal properties, executed across the two existing width tests.
